title: OSPF: Add support for Multi-Instance Extensions
description:
- Add support for OSPFv2 Multi-Instance Extensions (RFC 6549)
- Aligned rang_string values to IANA parameters for both,
  OSPFv2 and OSPFv3
- Renamed HF ospf.instance_id to ospf.v3.instance_id because the first
  is now used for OSPFv2 while the latter is explicitly for OSPFv3.

commits_data.title: OSPF: Add support for Multi-Instance Extensions
commits_data.message:
OSPF: Add support for Multi-Instance Extensions

- Add support for OSPFv2 Multi-Instance Extensions (RFC 6549)

  OSPFv2 and OSPFv3
- Renamed HF ospf.instance_id to ospf.v3.instance_id because the first
  is now used for OSPFv2 while the latter is explicitly for OSPFv3.
